headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.actualStep_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
          (Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.actualStep r c U L hr hc b h) =
        Math115.PhysicalCompletionOracle.referenceStepLaw r c U L
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none)
          (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.oracleFamily r c U L hr hc h
            ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
            ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
          ↑b

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.idealTrialLaw_mass_some
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (e : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  (Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.idealTrialLaw r c U L hr hc b).mass (some e) =
    Math115.PhysicalRationalKernel.proposalRat OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance *
        Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.crossRat r c U L hr hc b e /
      Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.weightRat r c U L hr hc b

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.idealTrialLaw_mass_some_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (e : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  ↑((Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.idealTrialLaw r c U L hr hc b).mass (some e)) =
    ↑(Math115.PhysicalRationalKernel.proposalRat OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance) *
        Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) b e /
      Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.balancedWeight r c U L b

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.actualTrialLaw_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.actualTrialLaw r c U L hr hc b h)
          (Math115.PhysicalStarTrial.idealTrialLaw r c U L hr hc b) ≤
        Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h
